description: What to do for each kind of failure: whether to retry, switch model, switch provider, ask the owner or stop. Used by the engine to turn a failure class into a next step.

QUOTA_EXHAUSTED.note: Use the quota rules: wait if the reset is known and within 12 hours, else block and ask.

MODEL_UNAVAILABLE.note: Refresh discovery and pick the next qualifying model before the phase starts.

RATE_LIMITED.note: Short wait, then retry the same model.

TIMEOUT.note: Retry once, then count it as an attempt.

TOOL_FAILURE.note: The tool failed, not the model: retry once, then report.

CAPABILITY_FAILURE.note: The model could not do it: re-brief once, then use a stronger tier.

BAD_BRIEF.note: Fix the brief and retry on the same tier.

AUTH_FAILURE.note: Login or key problem: only the owner can fix it.

CONTEXT_OVERFLOW.note: Split the task or move to a model with a larger context.

SAFETY_REFUSAL.note: Never rephrase around a refusal; ask the owner.

UNKNOWN.note: An unrecognised failure is never retried blindly.
